Chapter 628: Chapter 44 Treasures of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm opens once every two hundred thousand years, and once opened, it remains available for one hundred years.

The realm contains numerous opportunities and Xuanhuang Crystals within the indigenous life forms.

For the many Ninth Rank alien species of the cosmos, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is definitely considered a treasure trove, where merely one hundred years of its availability could equate to tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of years of their own accumulation.

If one could remain within the realm after it closes and wait until it opens again, imagine how great the harvest would be?

Two hundred thousand years, after all, is not considered a long time for Ninth Rank beings.

Therefore, in the early openings of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, most Ninth Rank alien species tried staying behind after the realm closed.

...

Even now, there are still Ninth Rank powerhouses undeterred, using various methods to try to remain within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

After all, the gains are immense, equating mere one hundred years to hundreds of thousands of years of accumulation; what about two hundred thousand years?

“So many?” Lin Yuan’s eyes lit up.

At a glance, Lin Yuan found approximately two hundred forty-eight Ninth-tier Secret Treasures, and there were also bodies of some special life forms, among other things.

The bodies of special life forms are very precious; they can be used to extract bloodlines to create Bloodline Potions. Lin Yuan had previously killed some special life forms during his raid in the Milky Way Star Region, turning them into Bloodline Potions.

Lin Yuan could foresee that with the lineage branch of bloodline cultivation within the Martial Path Evolutionary Path spreading, it would inevitably greatly promote the exploration of bloodlines in human civilization.

At that time, related special life form Bloodline Potions would be priceless.

“Finally…”

“It’s the heritage left by His Majesty.”

The Six-Armed Silhouette looked at Lin Yuan as the world changed again, bringing them to a space just a few miles in radius.

“His Majesty’s heritage is divided into two categories.”

“One is the Evolution Path.”

“The other is the Secret Technique.”

The Six-Armed Silhouette said.

“Evolution Path?” Lin Yuan was slightly stirred.

“Correct.”

“The Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path that you cultivate is the preliminary chapter of the Evolution Path left by His Majesty.”

The Six-Armed Silhouette raised its right hand toward Lin Yuan, and immediately a flood of information poured in.

The complete Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path… First Tier Chapter… Second Layer Chapter… Third Rank Chapter… Fourth Rank Chapter… Eighth Layer Part… Tenth Rank Chapter… Eleventh Stage Volume… Twelfth-stage Chapter…

From the First Tier Chapter to the Twelfth-stage Chapter, countless pieces of information were quickly absorbed by Lin Yuan.

“Indeed, it’s a Supreme Evolution Path…” Lin Yuan briefly checked and felt joy in his heart.

This was still Lin Yuan’s first encounter with a Supreme Evolutionary Path outside the nine great supreme paths of human civilization.

In the rewards for passing the third and fourth layers of the Demonic Jade Tower, there was indeed an incomplete Supreme Evolution Path, but Lin Yuan ultimately chose “Miniature Universe.”

“The Evolution Path left by the Master has too high a threshold; currently, no ultimate being has emerged yet,” the Six-Armed Silhouette remarked.

“No ultimate being has emerged yet?” Lin Yuan’s eyes brightened, which meant that this Evolution Path’s value was countless times greater than imagined.

The Supreme Evolutionary Paths are divided into two types.

One is the Supreme Evolutionary Path that has an ultimate being.

The other is the Supreme Evolutionary Path without an ultimate being.

The former is more common, such as the Nine Great Supreme Evolution Paths of human civilization, while the latter? It is extremely rare.

It even cannot be simply described as rare.

This signifies the quota for an ultimate being.

“But don’t hold too many hopes, I can sense that in other universes, there are some beings who have cultivated the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path to the eleventh rank,” the Six-Armed Silhouette added.

“Other universes?”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

His Majesty Xuanhuang originally developed thirty billion thirty-three million three hundred thirty-three Xuanhuang Secret Realms.

Even if most of these Xuanhuang Secret Realms have perished, a portion still remains.

One shouldn’t put all eggs in one basket, His Majesty Xuanhuang certainly understands this principle, and he would be able to obtain the heritage of this Xuanhuang Secret Realm; other places with Xuanhuang Secret Realms could similarly welcome suitable successors.

“This is the Secret Technique.”

The Six-Armed Silhouette pointed out once again.

In an instant, many pieces of information once again flooded into Lin Yuan’s mind.

After a long while.

Lin Yuan finally absorbed them.

His Majesty Xuanhuang left behind three types of Secret Techniques.

To be precise, three categories.

Attack.

Defense.

Escape.

The Attack Secret Technique is ‘Mysterious Yellow Strike’.

The Defense Secret Technique is ‘Primordial Yellow Physique’.

The Escape Secret Technique is ‘Time-Space Step’.

“This?”

Lin Yuan slightly contemplated, roughly understanding the effects of the three Secret Techniques, and his heart inevitably trembled.

When he became a Core Disciple of the Demonic Jade Tower, Lin Yuan also saw several Inheritance Secret Methods left by the Moyu Tower Master.

After repeated considerations, he chose the one that had the greatest effect on his own abilities, “‘Illusory Reality,'” which could fully utilize the Mysterious Gourd, significantly enhancing the combat power of his two Primordial Spirits, freeing it from an ineffectual position.

Lin Yuan choosing “Illusory Reality” didn’t mean the other Secret Techniques were inferior.

Now, however, the three Secret Techniques left by His Majesty Xuanhuang revealed to Lin Yuan just how terrifying the Secret Techniques created by a Supreme Being could be.

The first was the Mysterious Yellow Strike, gathering all one’s power and unleashing a strike that surpasses one’s own limits.

This Secret Technique was divided into four levels: the first level involves striking with double one’s own strength.

The second level allows one to strike with triple their own strength.

The third level permits a strike with quadruple their own strength.

The fourth level enables a strike with quintuple their own strength.

Lin Yuan’s ‘Strengthening’ skill in his Physical Body Divine Ability could instantaneously unleash a force exceeding ten times his own strength.

At first glance, it far surpasses the Secret Technique ‘Mysterious Yellow Strike’.

However, this is unsustainable and comes with a cost—temporary weakness for a while.

But the Mysterious Yellow Strike has no such consequence; once cultivated to the corresponding level, it can seamlessly be integrated into any strike.
